sections.bio:
I’m Dellyn Lee, a Talent Acquisition Recruiter with 10+ years of recruiting experience, a career content creator, and the founder of Dellyn Digital.

I previously worked as a Sr. Talent Acquisition Specialist for a multi-million-dollar company hiring across 48 states. Today, I still recruit but for people-focused organizations. I help them hire great talent while also helping job seekers level up their careers and life, using my skill points and the power of video games.

What makes my perspective different?

I’ve seen the job hunt from both sides of the screen, the recruiter side and the job seeker side. 

On October 2024, I was laid off on Halloween (made a video talking about it on my YouTube channel). 🎃 

Instead of letting that moment define me, I treated it like a new game plus run for my career and life. I used my recruiting experience, content creation skills, video editing skill tree, and my love of video games to navigate the job market.

80 days later, I landed my next role. I documented the journey and turned it into a YouTube series and channel, to help others understand how the modern job hunt actually works. But I wanted to take it to the next level.

Now, I use everything I’ve learned from reviewing 9,000+ resumes and hiring hundreds of people, to help others navigate the job search with confidence.

How I Help Job Seekers Level Up?

🎮 1:1 Coaching & Webinars: Resume strategy, LinkedIn optimization, and mock interviews
🎮 YouTube Content: Job-hunting tips and career strategy explained with a gaming twist
🎮 Courses & Digital Products: Step-by-step guidance, templates, and tools to make your job search more effective and fun

If you’re struggling with:

• Lack of clarity or personal branding
• Networking and interview confidence
• Knowing where to start with your resume
• The endless grind of the modern job hunt

You’re not alone. 

But, as the old man in The Legend of Zelda (1986) says: “It’s dangerous to go alone.”

If you’re not ready to Press Start yet, you can still:

→ Follow me here for gaming-inspired job hunt strategies
→ Check out my YouTube channel for career content and gaming Talent Acquisition Recruiter AMA livestreams

When you’re ready to take things to the next level…

Press Start with me and let’s take down the job hunt boss together.

Boeing is hiring.

Payloads Design Engineers (Associate & Experienced) in North Charleston, SC!

Boeing Commercial Airplanes is adding Associate and Experienced level Payloads Engineers to their Interiors Responsibility Center South Carolina (IRCSC) team. This is a fast-paced, dynamic role that spans the full product lifecycle, from customer configuration development all the way through production and certification. 

You'll touch cabin interiors, cargo compartments, exterior markings, and cabin safety systems. Your work quite literally shapes the passenger experience for airlines around the world.

What you'll be doing:

Developing, integrating & documenting structural and interior payload system requirements

Managing supplier performance, test & production coordination 

Validating & verifying systems and components meet design requirements

Developing & modifying payload system designs using 3D CAD tools

Supporting investigation of emerging technologies for future product concepts

Contributing to new design & analysis processes to improve quality & efficiency

You'll need:

✅ BS in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or STEM field

✅ 2+ years of related engineering experience (design, integration, or equivalent)

✅ 2+ years with 3D modeling tools (CATIA, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor, Pro-E, 3DX, or similar)

✅ Must be a U.S. Person — export control requirement

✅ Must pass Boeing's COI assessment & drug screening

Bonus if you have:

⭐ 5+ years in aerospace engineering & design criteria

⭐ 5+ years with 3D modeling tools

⭐ Experience working in cross-functional engineering teams

⭐ Background in aerospace engineering release processes

💰 Associate Level 2: $85,000 – $115,000

💰 Experienced Level 3: $103,700 – $140,300

📍 North Charleston, SC | Full-Time | 1st Shift | On-site only

🚚 Relocation assistance available based on eligibility

🚫 No visa sponsorship available

⏰ Applications close July 24, 2026

Boeing offers health insurance, HSA/FSA options, retirement savings plans, life & disability coverage, and paid time off programs.

Whether you're early in your engineering career or ready to bring years of aerospace experience to the table apply.

Know an engineer with a passion for design and a love of aviation? Tag them or share this post! 🔁

Sony says AI will be a bigger part of PlayStation’s future and is making it one of the company’s main priorities.

PlayStation CEO Hideaki Nishino said AI is already helping developers:

>handling repetitive work
>improving game testing
>supporting software development
>assisting with 3D models and animation
>enhancing PlayStation Store recommendations
>detecting fraud

Nishino said: “As a creative entertainment company, we prioritize our creators, with AI enhancing their work by removing repetitive tasks and enabling faster iteration and higher-quality outputs.”

“At the same time, we are experimenting at a more fundamental level with smaller, AI-first initiatives, while remaining realistic about near-term efficiency gains.”

A new rumor claims GTA VI will launch with two graphics modes on PS5 and Xbox Series X: a 30 FPS Quality Mode and a 60 FPS Performance Mode…

The claim comes from the Polish podcast Rock and Borys, which says it spoke to sources close to Rockstar. 

The podcast has previously reported accurate Rockstar-related information, including The Witcher 3 expansion before it was officially announced.

According to the rumor, if the 60 FPS mode isn’t ready for launch, Rockstar plans to add it in a post-launch update.
